name: aspen-plus
description: Control Aspen Plus from your coding agent via the COM API: build and edit flowsheets, configure property methods and reactions, run simulations, optimize with 9 algorithms (NSGA-II/III, PSO, DE, BO, CBO, AFM-CBO, gradient, grid search), and run pinch analysis. Bundles a doc-lookup subagent and an error diagnose-fix-record-share workflow.
